release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.12 Performance Pass 1. Optimized Library browsing with a small 3-second bounded SQLite count cache for page changes, invalidated on local song updates/scans. Skips obsolete searches before SQL in both the full Library and floating song list. Built on Stable Build 15.10.11 (vc72) with Smart Melody, black-gold UI, disclaimer rotation fix and lyric look-ahead retained. No MIDI synthesis, SoundFont, tempo/lyric events, scoring, queue ordering or remote protocol changes. Performance gains are not yet benchmarked; device QA required. Experimental packed library remains excluded. Stable/Beta untouched.
